tweaks.name: Diagnostic data: Required only
tweaks.description: Sets the official 'Allow diagnostic data' policy to Required, the lowest level Home and Pro accept, so no optional diagnostic data is collected. The telemetry service itself is turned off separately (services.diagtrack).

tweaks.name: Turn off advertising ID
tweaks.description: Apps can no longer use your advertising ID to show personalized ads. Sets both the policy and the Settings switch.

tweaks.name: Turn off tailored experiences
tweaks.description: Microsoft stops using your diagnostic data to personalize tips, offers and recommendations shown in Windows.

tweaks.name: Turn off activity history
tweaks.description: Windows stops recording which apps, files and websites you open on this PC and never uploads that history to your Microsoft account.

tweaks.name: Never ask for feedback
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from popping up feedback questions and from downloading new feedback surveys. Feedback Hub still works if you open it yourself.

tweaks.name: Turn off inking & typing personalization
tweaks.description: Windows stops building a personal dictionary from what you type and write and stops sending typing and inking samples to Microsoft. Normal spell check and keyboard suggestions keep working.

tweaks.name: Turn off app-launch tracking
tweaks.description: Windows stops tracking which apps you start in order to rank Start and search results. Side effect: the 'Show most used apps' option in Start becomes unavailable.

tweaks.name: Turn off online speech recognition
tweaks.description: Switches off the 'Online speech recognition' setting, so your voice is not sent to Microsoft's cloud speech service. Voice typing (Win+H) needs this setting; you can switch it back on any time in Settings > Privacy & security > Speech. Game voice chat is not affected.

tweaks.name: Block online speech recognition for everyone (policy)
tweaks.description: Applies the 'Allow users to enable online speech recognition services' policy as disabled, machine-wide. Voice typing (Win+H) and other cloud dictation stop working for every account and cannot be switched back on in Settings until you revert this, which matters for dictation and accessibility users; game voice chat is not affected.

tweaks.name: Don't share your language list with websites
tweaks.description: Websites can no longer read your Windows language list to tailor locally relevant content.

tweaks.name: Keep Windows search off your cloud accounts
tweaks.description: Start search stops looking through OneDrive, Outlook and other Microsoft or work account cloud content. Local apps, files and settings are still found.

tweaks.name: Turn off Customer Experience Improvement Program
tweaks.description: Turns off CEIP with the official policy and disables its data-collection tasks (CEIP consolidator, USB CEIP, Autochk proxy, disk diagnostic data collector). Nothing you use day to day changes.

tweaks.name: Disable Compatibility Appraiser tasks
tweaks.description: Stops the Compatibility Appraiser (CompatTelRunner.exe) from periodically scanning all installed programs, a known source of CPU and disk spikes. Downside: Windows Update may hold back the next Windows feature update (monthly security updates are not affected), and Windows Backup can no longer list your desktop apps for restore.

tweaks.name: Turn off Windows Error Reporting
tweaks.description: Crash and hang reports are no longer sent to Microsoft and the queued-report upload task is disabled. Downside: no 'Problem reports' solutions, and developers who rely on Windows crash reports (some games included) get no data from your PC.
